sections.st: Custom Plastic Packaging Manufactured from One Vapi Facility
leads: Trizen Packaging is a custom plastic packaging manufacturer in India producing the complete range of thermoformed rigid plastic packaging — custom product trays, pharmaceutical blister packs, retail clamshell packaging, medical device blister components, industrial equipment enclosures, and heavy-gauge machinery panels — all from a single ISO 9001:2015 certified, GMP validated, Cleanroom Class 8 facility in Vapi, Daman.

As a plastic packaging manufacturer from Vapi, Daman, we eliminate the most common commercial and regulatory sourcing problem: needing multiple separate suppliers for multiple packaging formats across the same product range.

sections.st: The Multi-Supplier Problem — Why One Manufacturer Matters
leads: Procurement managers sourcing plastic packaging across multiple product lines consistently face the same structural problem:

rows: Separate qualification audit for each packaging format
4 formats = 4 audits, 4 quality relationships, 4 annual re-qualification cycles
One ISO 9001:2015 + GMP + Cleanroom Class 8 qualification covers all 6 plastic packaging formats from Vapi
Inconsistent documentation standards
Different batch record formats from each supplier — manual reconciliation for regulatory submissions
Uniform GMP batch records and material COAs across all packaging formats. One documentation format.
Split tooling ownership
Product redesign requires contacting multiple suppliers — multiple tooling queues and timelines
All tooling for all 6 formats CNC-fabricated and held in-house at Vapi. One call revises the entire programme.
Misaligned lead times and MOQs
Coordinating production across multiple suppliers increases planning complexity and shortage risk
Single facility. All formats: prototype in 7–14 business days, production from confirmed order.

sections.st: 6 Plastic Packaging Formats — Manufactured at Vapi
leads: Rigid plastic thermoformed packaging across all six formats from in-house CNC tooling at our Vapi facility:

products.name: Thermoformed Trays
products.desc: Custom-cavitied trays from 6mm device trays to 500mm automotive staging trays. PP, PETG, APET, HIPS, ABS in 0.20–8.00mm gauge.

products.name: Vacuum Forming
products.desc: ~1 bar vacuum. Cost-efficient for standard commercial packaging geometries and high-volume programmes.

products.name: Pressure Forming
products.desc: 4–11 bar combined force. ±0.5mm tolerance, sharp corners, fine surface detail on both faces. Injection moulding quality at thermoforming tooling cost.

products.name: Blister Packaging
products.desc: 7 blister formats: PVC, PVDC, Alu-Alu, APET retail, Tyvek-compatible medical device components, CR child-resistant, tamper-evident. GMP + Cleanroom Class 8.

products.name: Clamshell Packaging
products.desc: 5 formats: hinged snap-close, heat-sealed tamper-evident, clamshell blister, full-face clear, RF/ultrasonic welded security.

products.name: Industrial Enclosures
products.desc: Heavy-gauge PP and ABS structural panels, equipment enclosures, machinery casing. 1–8mm gauge for industrial equipment OEMs.

faqs.q: What does a custom plastic packaging manufacturer in India produce?
faqs.a: Trizen Packaging is a custom plastic packaging manufacturer in India producing the complete range of rigid thermoformed plastic packaging — custom product trays, pharmaceutical blister packs (PVC, PVDC, Alu-Alu, Tyvek-compatible medical device blister components), retail clamshell packaging (snap-close, heat-sealed, RF-welded), pressure formed precision packaging for medical devices and automotive, and heavy-gauge industrial enclosures in PP and ABS. All packaging manufactured from custom CNC tooling at our Vapi facility under ISO 9001:2015, GMP, and Cleanroom Class 8.

faqs.q: Can you manufacture multiple plastic packaging formats from one facility?
faqs.a: Yes. All six plastic packaging formats manufactured from the same Vapi facility — one ISO 9001:2015 + GMP + Cleanroom Class 8 qualification covers everything. Multi-format OEM manufacturing programmes are a core capability for pharmaceutical companies, medical device OEMs, automotive OEMs, and FMCG brands with multiple packaging requirements.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: Minimum 500 units for all formats — including pharmaceutical GMP blister, medical device sterile blister components (Cleanroom Class 8), commercial retail clamshells, and industrial enclosures. OEM manufacturing programmes from 10,000 units per order with repeat order management from Vapi.

faqs.q: How long from product sample to first prototype?
faqs.a: 7 to 14 business days from product sample to first physical prototype for all plastic packaging formats — including cavity design, CNC mould fabrication at Vapi, and dimensional inspection. All tooling in-house. No outsourced delays. Same timeline for a standard retail tray, a pressure formed medical device blister, or a pharmaceutical Alu-Alu blister.
